requirements.text: Define one strict shared runtime contract for successful exact Direct certificates.
Bind every certificate to dataset, snapshot, query, BGP, active dataset, authorization, OWL signature, datatype policy and active graph context.
Bind the certificate to a scheduling-independent digest of the exact Phase 40.3 Direct-BGP result.
Represent exhaustive finite-candidate completeness with exact reasoner and distributed-partition completion evidence.
Define reasoner identity and closed proof/support reference vocabulary without falsely claiming proof-DAG completeness.
Verify the certificate/result/expected immutable identities at the reasoner client boundary and fail closed on mismatch.
Provide Draft 2020-12 schema, valid/invalid fixtures, independent validation, documentation, inheritance evidence and cumulative gates.
